item.title: SGA passes RSO funding program, calls for mandatory ALICE training
item.description: The EIU Student Senate approved the creation of a Registered Student Organization grant funding program at its meeting on Wednesday. item.title: Third quarter run lifts UT Martin to 62-46 win over EIU
item.description: UT Martin went on a 14-2 run and outscored EIU women’s basketball 21-11 in the third quarter to pull away for a 62-46 win on Thursday at Groniger Arena.
